//: Hosting is NOT configured in this build. CareGrid AI is deployed to Vercel (docs/19_DEPLOYMENT_DEVOPS.md §3); this file exists so `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules` works, and so a reviewer can see that the Hosting target was considered and deliberately left unset rather than forgotten.
//deploy_command: npm run build && npx vercel --prod   (the frontend). For the backend: vercel deploy. For the rules: npx firebase-tools deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,storage
//why_no_hosting: A second hosting target would mean a second build pipeline, a second set of environment variables, and a second origin to keep in the CSRF allow-list — for the same static output. One target is fewer ways for the security headers to differ between environments.
